shown.message:
The Outline is now rev 9 and pushed. It has a new §3b recording what each pre-fixed rule gave on `experiment-repo`'s results (`story-repo`#7: 91 data sets, synced at paper-repo `dev` d202c30). The lead still stands, and nothing needs to go back to `idea-repo`.

What the rules gave, as `experiment-repo` reports it:
- **C1:** the real data sit within the ±0.15 margin of the same-graph null. Arena-55k flip is within the margin but not zero (+0.056 [0.013, 0.099]). Q ≈ 1.1 and flat F/z are close to a first-order identity, so Q and F stay a gauge rather than the finding.
- **C2:** random deletion or flipping essentially never reverses a pair at the adversary's budget. The comparison is therefore a lower bound, and the paper will claim no ratio.
- **C3:** in the large crowd and LLM sets, CI-separated pairs lose their separation under a targeted change at small fractions of N. They survive every random budget.
- **C4:** all matched contrasts are within the margin, except MT-Bench human vs GPT-4 deletion, which is inconclusive (5 pairs). Design is confounded with data set (one expert set, two crowd sets).
- **C5:** the predictive rule transfers across data sets within a design, with held-out error of about 0.2 in log k\*. It transfers less well across designs, with error of 0.3–1.0 in log k\*. The design terms add little.
- **C6:** one-shot influence reaches the best k\* exactly for only 53–95% of conclusions. The paper will call k\* a verified upper bound and the LP value an uncertified candidate.
- **Not run:** insertion, Arena-140k and slices, WebDev Arena, Rao–Kupper/Davidson ties, and the NBA home-advantage check.

**Open check:** `experiment-repo`'s issue says the real data sit within the margin in "every data set". My recount of `real_minus_null.csv` gives 177 of 180 rows. The other three are MT-Bench GPT-4 matched deletion, NBA 1948 deletion and NBA 1957 deletion, all with few pairs. I asked them on #7 to confirm or correct the count, and also to confirm how I read the log-N coefficient (0.15/0.25) in C5. It is conditional on z, density and ties, so it differs from the calibration's 0.45.
